assets.prompt: BRINE underwater station-builder exterior wreckage prop. One collapsed seabed acoustic sensor mast lying flat, strongly overhead orthographic camera, no horizon. A bent short turquoise-painted steel lattice arm connects physically to a broken shallow circular acoustic receiver dish, its off-white face cracked with one missing wedge exposing dark ribs. A short black cable snakes from the damaged connector and ends loose beside the arm. Asymmetric grounded silhouette, broad visible top surfaces, very shallow south-facing relief. Tactile detailed game art consistent with corroded turquoise underwater station girders: localized rusty edges, barnacles at joints, sparse dull olive fouling, quiet diffuse light. Industrial sensor equipment, not a weapon or active antenna tower. No glow, beam, bubbles, text, ground slab, sand patch or blue wash. Entire object centered with generous transparent margins on all sides and transparent gaps through lattice. True transparent RGBA background. Square native image. Small decorative wreckage about half a station room wide.
